references.text: Here Psalm 77 describes how God walked through the sea and the waters, but his footprints were invisible, which may remind one of Jesus walking on water in Mark 6:49.
After Jesus' resurrection, when he appears to the disciples, they first think they are seeing a ghost, which resembles their reaction in Mark 6:49.
John also tells of an event where Jesus walks on water; although the disciples' reaction of thinking they see a ghost is not mentioned, it points to a similar miraculous act as in Mark 6:49.
